title: Shared atoms of the router-api contract
description: Referenced by the other router-api schemas; validates nothing on its own. Identifiers, versions, amounts, timestamps, nodes and denominations are the provider-role contract's, by reference.

endpoint.description: A node and an asset, with the unit the asset is counted in there: one whole asset is 10^decimals units (REQ-CAT-11). The node is an inner node by identifier, or an outer node by its network (REQ-CAT-17).

ratio.description: A rational number, numerator / denominator, in whole numbers so that no figure is rounded on the way in.

call_kind.description: The kind of a cross-module call: a provider-role operation kind, as urn:rutent:provider-role:operation names it and as the module interface's declaration and call records use it (REQ-MDL-21), but never holding_balance, the operator's own question to a holding, which no module may call for. Not the typed operation's kind: a call asks a module for one provider-role operation.

declared_call.description: One cross-module call a provider's module declares, as its release's outside.calls lists it (module-interface, REQ-MDL-21): the provider whose module it may call, and the kinds it may ask of it, each once.

callee.description: The provider whose module may be called.

kinds.description: The kinds that may be asked of it, each once.

route_call.description: One cross-module call a route segment names (REQ-MDL-21, THR-86): in that segment, the operation's provider's module may call callee's for kind. The platform lets a module call another only where its release declares the call and a segment of its route names it.

callee.description: The provider whose module may be called: the provider of another operation of the same part.
